name: sky130A
about: SkyWater SKY130, as installed by open_pdks or as the skywater-pdk-libs-sky130_fd_pr repository

errata.why: ngspice refuses an include without its dot (Not enough parameters, fatal), and no file has that name; the ESD transistor is in ../esd_nfet_05v0_nvt

errata.was: sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po r0 r1 sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po__monte r = {r_tot} tc1r = {tc1} tc2r = {tc2}
errata.read: Rsky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po r0 r1 sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po__monte r = {r_tot} tc1 = {tc1} tc2 = {tc2}
errata.why: ngspice reads a line starting with s as a switch, and its resistor has no tc1r or tc2r instance parameter; open_pdks ships the R and tc1, tc2 form
the subcircuit's name comes after its parameters, and ngspice refuses the instance (unknown subckt)
